LanguageData.RR_ProvisionerCaretakerDesc: Choose the Provisioner caring for this egg-laying animal. While the caretaker is capable and present on this map, egg production receives their food-yield bonus. Each animal has one caretaker.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceMigrated: {0}: Abundant Table is now a shared-feast ritual. Its former meme has become Embodied Abundance, including leadership body expectations and the Feeder, Feedee and Provisioner roles. Existing role holders are preserved.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceBedOwnerMismatch: The bed must belong to the matching leader, moral guide or Feedee of its designated Embodied Abundance ideoligion.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceBedDesignationDesc: Designate this large single bed for its owner's rituals. Normal bed ownership and bedroom benefits remain. Select the role that its owner holds.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceBedNeedsOwner: Assign this bed to a member of Embodied Abundance first.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceTableTarget: Dining table, ritual spot or altar
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceInvalid: The ritual needs a valid site and meal service.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceHostRequired: Assign this bed's capable, awake owner as the host.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceServerRequired: Assign a mobile attendant who can collect food and reach the bedside.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceHostCannotSettle: The host cannot reach and settle in their designated bed.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceSeats: {0} guests need seats. This room has {1} available. Add table chairs or ritual seats, or invite fewer guests.
LanguageData.RR_FeastStartSummary: Helpers bring immobile guests to the table and serve the leader, moral guide and anyone else who needs feeding.
LanguageData.RR_CeremonyStartSummary: The attendant brings food to the host's bed and feeds them there.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceSeatUnavailable: No free, reachable seat for {0}. Check seating, paths and reservations.

LanguageData.RR_FeastCollectorRequired: Invite a mobile guest who can collect food.

LanguageData.RR_FeastServerSpace: Leave a free space beside {0}'s seat for the guest serving them.
LanguageData.RR_FeastBedOnlyAttendant: A bedside attendant is only needed at a ritual bed.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceNoMeal: No unreserved, reachable prepared meal permitted for {0}.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceNoDiners: No selected diner has room for food.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceMealExplanation: Guests bring prepared food to the tables. A full guest can join the conversation, serve others and eat later from a packed dish or a working dispenser in the room. Leaders and moral guides receive help eating up to 10% above comfortable fullness, within their physical limit. Other diners eat up to comfortable fullness. Ceremonial feeding also permits 10% more. A bed host requires an attendant.
LanguageData.RR_FeastEmergencyDuty: {0} is handling an emergency and cannot join the feast.
LanguageData.RR_FeastPackedForLater: A dish is set aside for {0} if they get hungry.
LanguageData.RR_FeastDispenserForLater: {0} can use the dispenser in the room if they get hungry.
LanguageData.RR_FeastNoLaterDish: There is no permitted dish for {0} to bring and no usable dispenser in the room.
LanguageData.RR_FeastNoLaterDishInRoom: {0} needs a permitted dish to bring or set aside, or a usable dispenser in the ritual room. Fetching food from outside is switched off.
LanguageData.RR_FeastLateMealUnavailable: {0} stayed at the gathering, but their reserved dish or dispenser was no longer available.
LanguageData.RR_FeastActualQuality: {0} diners contributed +{1}. The meals they ate contributed +{2}.

LanguageData.RR_FeastExpectedQuality: {0} diners are expected to eat, contributing +{1}. Their planned meals contribute +{2}. Final quality uses the food actually eaten.
LanguageData.RR_AbundanceDigestionReward: The recipient has {0}% faster digestion for one day.
